detail: Full summary: Claude Code 2.1.272 hook surface is far larger than the 5 events the plugin uses: 33 events surveyed, 12 can inject context (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Stop, DirectoryAdded, PostModelSwitch); PreCompact/PostCompact/SessionEnd cannot. Codex 0.154.0 has exactly 12 hook events; 5 inject (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SubagentStart); no Notification event; resume is SessionStart with source=resume; SessionEnd has no output schema.
